# Command line

Generated from `voxprint-lucent --help`, the Python module parser, and `voxprint-lucent-tools --help`.

## Viewer

The installed application is this program.

```text
voxprint-lucent — image viewer

Usage:
  voxprint-lucent --help
  voxprint-lucent --version
  voxprint-lucent --dry-run [IMAGE]
  voxprint-lucent --benchmark IMAGE [--navigate-next IMAGE]
  voxprint-lucent [IMAGE]

--help
    Show this text and exit 0. No window is created.

--version
    Print the build label and exit 0. No window is created.
    This flag wins over --dry-run, --benchmark, and an image path.

--dry-run [IMAGE]
    Check startup and the Enlarge hand-off, print one JSON object, and exit.
    No window, no GPU, and no single-instance socket. The tools process is not started.
    Exit 0 when IMAGE is omitted or exists and the Enlarge probe succeeds.
    Exit 3 when IMAGE does not exist.
    Enlarge is LUCENT_ENLARGE_EXE when that program exists, otherwise voxprint-enlarge on PATH.
    When Enlarge is absent, enlarge.installed is false and enlarge.install_url is the releases page.
    When Enlarge is present, Lucent runs: voxprint-enlarge --capabilities --json
    If IMAGE was given and that probe exits 0, Lucent then runs:
    voxprint-enlarge --input IMAGE --scale 2 --preset photo --format avif --json-progress --dry-run
    A non-zero Enlarge status becomes Lucent's status. A missing image still exits 3.
    Combined with --benchmark, --dry-run wins and FIRST_PIXEL is not printed.

--benchmark IMAGE
    Paint IMAGE, print FIRST_PIXEL, and exit. The tools process is not started.
    --navigate-next IMAGE opens that second image and prints NAVIGATE_PIXEL.
    Exit 2 when IMAGE is missing.

IMAGE
    Picture to open. A second launch forwards the path to the instance already running.

Exit status:
    0  the command finished
    2  --benchmark was given without an image
    3  --dry-run was given a path that is not a file
```

## Python module

A source checkout's `voxprint-lucent` console script uses this parser. It can also export a copy. The installed viewer is the program above.

```text
usage: voxprint-lucent [-h] [--benchmark] [--navigate-next NAVIGATE_NEXT]
                       [--export [EXPORT]] [--format FORMAT] [--lossless]
                       [--version]
                       [image]

Voxprint AI Lucent, a fast colour-accurate image viewer.

positional arguments:
  image                 Image file to open

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --benchmark           Paint the image, print FIRST_PIXEL, then quit
  --navigate-next NAVIGATE_NEXT
                        With --benchmark, time a switch to this already-
                        decoded neighbour
  --export [EXPORT]     Save a copy and quit. Default format is AVIF.
  --format FORMAT       Output format for --export: avif (default), jxl, webp,
                        jpeg, heic. PNG is rejected.
  --lossless            Lossless JPEG XL or WebP when that format is selected
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## Tools

`voxprint-lucent-tools` is the on-demand helper. The viewer starts it when you open the info panel or Enlarge.

```text
usage: voxprint-lucent-tools [-h] [--ping] [--path PATH] [--enlarge]
                             [--check-update]

Voxprint AI Lucent tools host. Not part of viewer startup.

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --ping          Answer without loading Qt. Used to prove this process is
                  separate.
  --path PATH     Image the viewer had open.
  --enlarge       Open the Enlarge hand-off for --path instead of the info
                  panel.
  --check-update  Read this repository's GitHub releases and print a newer
                  tag.
```
